map.DN4问卷(Douleur Neuropathique 4)，筛查神经病理性疼痛: DN4 questionnaire (Douleur Neuropathique 4), screens neuropathic pain; total 0-10, ≥4 suggests neuropathic pain
map.DN4 神经病理性疼痛量表 = 症状描述 7 项 + 体格检查 3 项（每项 1: DN4 neuropathic pain scale = 7 symptom-description items + 3 physical-exam items (1 point each), max 10; total ≥4 judged neuropathic, <4 nociceptive pain.
map.神经病理性疼痛：烧灼样、电击样、针刺样，伴感觉异常（麻木/蚁走感）: Neuropathic pain: burning, electric-shock-like, needling-like, with paresthesia (numbness/crawling sensation)
map.伤害感受性疼痛：搏动性、酸痛、钝痛，与组织损伤相关: Nociceptive pain: throbbing, aching, dull, related to tissue damage

map.一线药物：加巴喷丁/普瑞巴林、三环类抗抑郁药、SNRI类: First-line drugs: gabapentin/pregabalin, tricyclic antidepressants, SNRIs
map.DN4是国际公认的神经病理性疼痛筛查工具，操作简便，10项每项1分（是=1，否=: DN4 is an internationally recognized neuropathic pain screening tool, simple to use, 10 items 1 point each (yes=1, no=0). First 7 are patient-reported symptoms, last 3 are clinical examination. Total ≥4 suggests possible neuropathic pain, requiring further etiology clarification (diabetic peripheral neuropathy, post-herpetic neuralgia, trigeminal neuralgia, sciatica, etc.) and targeted treatment.
map.带状疱疹后痛、糖尿病周围神经病变评估。: Post-herpetic neuralgia, diabetic peripheral neuropathy assessment.
map.症状项（烧灼、针刺、麻木等）选中 3 项 + 查体项（触觉减退、针刺阈升等）3: Symptom items (burning, needling, numbness, etc.) 3 selected + exam items (decreased touch, raised pinprick threshold, etc.) 3 = 6 ≥4: neuropathic pain positive.
map.合计 2 分 <4：不符合神经病理性痛特征。: Total 2 <4: does not meet neuropathic pain features.
map.总分 ≥4 提示神经病理性痛，敏感性特异性均较高。: Total ≥4 suggests neuropathic pain, both sensitivity and specificity high.
map.4 项症状 + 6 项查体，各计 1 分，满分 10。: 4 symptom items + 6 exam items, 1 point each, max 10.
